title: Brass: Birmingham
scope: Setup, then rounds of turns through the Canal Era and the Rail Era, each ending with scoring; 2–4 players on one phone

victory.note: After the Rail Era is scored, the player with the most VPs wins. Ties go to the highest income, then the most money; if still tied, those players draw.

citations.excerpt: The player with the most VPs is declared the winner.
Ties are broken, first by the highest income, and then by the most money remaining.

sources.title: Rulebook (v2018.11; two printed pages per PDF page)

states.title: Rail Era
states.trigger: The Canal Era ends after the round in which every player uses the last card in their hand.

citations.excerpt: Each era ends following the round in which all players use the final cards in their Hands.

event.title: End of the Canal Era
bullets: Links: each of your Link tiles scores 1 VP for each link icon in the locations next to it. Remove Link tiles as they score.
Industries: then score the VPs in the bottom left corner of your flipped Industry tiles (black top half). Unflipped tiles don’t score.
Remove every level 1 Industry tile from the board (not from Player Mats). Level 2 and up stay.
Put 1 beer barrel on each empty beer space beside a (non-blank) Merchant tile.
Shuffle everyone’s Discard Piles into a new Draw Deck (turn the face-down bottom card over first).
Each player draws 8 cards. The Rail Era begins.

steps.title: Board and cards
steps.instruction: Place the board on its day or night side, then prepare the cards:
bullets: Fewer than 4 players: return to the box every card and Merchant tile showing a player count higher than yours (bottom right of cards, top of Merchant tiles).
Place the Wild Location and Wild Industry cards face up on 2 of the Card Draw Areas.
Shuffle the rest into the Draw Deck, face down on the last Card Draw Area.

citations.excerpt: Place the board on either the day or night side.
For a player count of less than 4, remove all cards and Merchant tiles that show a player count greater than your number of players, and return them to the box.
Shuffle the remaining cards and place them face down on the remaining Card Draw Area

steps.title: Merchants and markets
steps.instruction: Set up the Merchants, Markets and supply:
bullets: Shuffle the Merchant tiles and place 1 face up on each Merchant space marked with your player count (2 players: none in Warrington and Nottingham; 3 players: none in Nottingham).
1 beer barrel on each beer space beside a (non-blank) Merchant tile.
Coal Market: a black cube on every space but one of the £1 spaces. Iron Market: an orange cube on every space but both £1 spaces.
The other cubes and barrels beside the board are the General Supply (limitless); the money is the Bank.

citations.excerpt: Shuffle the remaining Merchant tiles, and place 1 (face up) on each of the Merchant spaces marked with the number of players in your game
Place 1 beer barrel on each beer barrel space beside a (non-blank) Merchant tile
Place 1 black cube on each space of the Coal Market
Place 1 orange cube on each space of the Iron Market
Note: The General Supply is limitless.

steps.title: Your player area
bullets: A Player Mat, £17 from the Bank and a Character tile.
Your colour’s Link tiles beside you, and its Industry tiles stacked on their slots on your Player Mat (black top half face down).
VP Marker on 0 and Income Marker on 10 of the Progress Track.

citations.excerpt: Place the matching coloured Link tiles in your player area
Choose a coloured Character tile.
The side of the tiles with the black top half should be face down.
Place your Victory Point (VP) Marker on the “0” space of the Progress Track
Place your Income Marker on the “10” space of the Progress Track

steps.title: Hands and turn order
steps.instruction: Deal the cards and set the first turn order:
bullets: Each player draws 8 cards (keep your Hand hidden), plus 1 more face down beside them: their Discard Pile.
Shuffle the Character tiles and place them in a random order on the Turn Order Track.

citations.excerpt: Draw 8 cards from the Draw Deck; this is your Hand.
Draw 1 additional card from the Draw Deck and place it face down in your player area; this is your Discard Pile.
shuffle all players’ Character tiles together and place them in a random order on the Turn Order Track

loop.note: Take turns in the order of the Character tiles on the Turn Order Track.

citations.excerpt: During each round, players take turns in the order of their Character tiles on the Turn Order Track.

steps.title: Your 2 actions
steps.instruction: Take 2 actions (only 1 each in the Canal Era’s first round). Discard a card for each. Choose from:
bullets: Build: needs a Location card (that location) or an Industry card (that industry, in your network). Pay the cost from your Player Mat and use any coal and iron.
Network: place a Link tile next to your network.
Develop: remove 1 or 2 of the lowest Industry tiles from your Player Mat, using 1 iron each.
Sell: flip a Cotton Mill, Manufacturer or Pottery connected to a Merchant buying it, using the beer shown.
Loan: take £30 and move your Income Marker back 3 income levels.
Scout: discard 2 more cards and take 1 Wild Location and 1 Wild Industry (not if you hold a Wild card).
You may take the same action twice, or pass (still discarding a card).

citations.excerpt: On your turn, perform a total of 2 actions.
During the first round of the Canal Era, each player performs only 1 action.
For each action you perform, you must discard a card from your Hand and place it face up on top of your Discard Pile.
May be used to build any Industry tile at the location named on the card, even if the location is not a part of your network.
May be used to build the Industry tile matching an icon shown in the top corner of the card, in a location that is a part of your network.
The placed Link tile must be adjacent to a location that is a part of your network
Remove 1 or 2 Industry tiles from your Player Mat, and return them to the box.
Consume 1 iron for each tile removed
Choose 1 of your unflipped Cotton Mill, Manufacturer
Take £30 from the bank, and move your Income Marker 3 income levels (not spaces) backwards down the Progress Track
You may not perform this action if you already have a Wild card in your Hand.
You may choose to pass instead of performing an action, but must still discard a card for each action you pass.

additions.title: Canal Era
additions.text: Building and links in the Canal Era:
bullets: At most 1 of your Industry tiles per location.
Canal Links only: 1 per Network action, for £3.

citations.excerpt: You may have a maximum of 1 Industry tile per location, but may have an Industry tile in the same location as other players.
You may build a maximum of 1 canal Link for £3.

additions.title: Rail Era
additions.text: Building and links in the Rail Era:
bullets: You may build several Industry tiles in a location.
Rail Links only, each using 1 coal: 1 for £5, or 2 for £15 plus 1 beer from a Brewery.

citations.excerpt: You may build multiple Industry tiles in each location.
You may build 1 rail Link for £5.
In a single Network action, you may build 2 rail Links for £15, if you also consume 1 beer.
You must consume 1 coal for each rail Link built

steps.title: End of your turn
steps.instruction: Refill your Hand back up to 8 cards from the Draw Deck.
bullets: Once the Draw Deck is empty, your Hand shrinks each round until you have no cards left.

citations.excerpt: After all of your actions have been completed, refill your Hand back up to 8 cards with cards from the Draw Deck.
Once the Draw Deck has been exhausted, your Hand will decrease each round until you have no cards left.

reminders.text: All the money you spent this turn is on your Character tile on the Turn Order Track.

citations.excerpt: Place all money spent during your turn on top of your Character tile on the Turn Order Track.

reminders.text: Wild cards you used went back to their Card Draw Areas, not your Discard Pile.

citations.excerpt: Wild cards are placed back onto their Card Draw Areas.

reminders.text: Any Coal Mine or Iron Works emptied this turn is flipped, and its owner’s income goes up.

citations.excerpt: Coal Mines, Iron Works, and Breweries: Flip when the last resource is removed from the tile.

steps.title: Turn order
steps.instruction: Rearrange the Character tiles on the Turn Order Track:
bullets: Whoever spent the least money this round goes first next round, and so on; whoever spent the most goes last.
Equal amounts keep their relative order.
Then return all the money on the Character tiles to the Bank.

citations.excerpt: The player who spent the least money this round will go first next round
If multiple players have spent an equal amount, their relative turn order remains the same
Afterwards, take all money from the Character tiles, and place it back into the Bank

steps.title: Income
steps.instruction: Each player takes money from the Bank equal to their income level (the coin beside their Income Marker).
bullets: Negative income: pay it to the Bank.
Can’t pay? Remove your own Industry tiles from the board for half their cost each (rounded down), stopping once you have enough; if you still can’t, lose 1 VP per £1 short.
No income after the game’s final round.

citations.excerpt: Take money from the Bank equal to your income level.
you must pay that amount of money to the Bank.
you must acquire money by removing one or more of your Industry tiles (not Link tiles) from the board; each being worth half of its cost, rounded down.
If you have no way to pay a shortfall, lose 1 VP (if possible) for each £1 you are short.
Income is not collected at the end of the final round of the game.

additions.title: End of the Canal Era?
additions.text: Did every player just use the last card in their Hand? Then the Canal Era ends now (8/9/10 rounds with 4/3/2 players).

citations.excerpt: Each era ends following the round in which all players use the final cards in their Hands.
There are exactly 8/9/10 rounds per era in a 4/3/2-players game.

additions.title: End of the game?
additions.text: Did every player just use the last card in their Hand? Then the Rail Era and the game end (no income this time). Score the era:
bullets: Links: each of your Link tiles scores 1 VP for each link icon in the locations next to it. Remove Link tiles as they score.
Industries: then score the VPs in the bottom left corner of your flipped Industry tiles (black top half). Unflipped tiles don’t score.
Most VPs wins. End the game from the Game menu.
